title: Evaluation model and score aggregation
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.

models.name: EvaluationDocument
models.work: schema, repo, scoring logic, aggregate + conclude actions

build: src/lib/defense/scoring.ts (pure): clampScores(rubric, scores), computeTotal(rubric, scores), normalise(total, maxScore) -> 0..100, compositeScore(rubric, supervisorEval|null, panelEvals[]) = supervisor*supervisor_weight_pct/100 + panelAvg*panel_weight_pct/100 rounded to 2 dp; returns incomplete when the supervisor or all panel evaluations are missing. Exhaustive unit tests (different max_score, unknown criterion keys ignored, idempotent).
models/evaluation (schema, repo) and src/lib/defense/eval-id.ts: evaluationId(teamId, evaluatorUid) = `${teamId}__${uid}__team`. student_id is always null in v1.

src/app/actions/aggregate-defense.ts: callable by the panel chair of the team's panel, coordinator or admin. Loads the rubric referenced by the evaluations, recomputes every total from scores (ignores client total_score), counts only evaluations from the team's assigned supervisor and members of the team's panel, writes team.scores_summary {supervisor_score, panel_average_score, composite_final_score, is_locked:false} (grade_classification stays unset), returns the list of missing evaluators. Re-running gives the identical result.
src/app/actions/conclude-defense-slot.ts: panel chair or coordinator; sets the slot status completed, then runs the aggregation.

Server tests: 1 supervisor + 3 panelists aggregate, outsider evaluations ignored, tampered total_score ignored, idempotent rerun, non-chair rejected. Extend the rules test: evaluator write denied once is_published is true.
acceptance: Scoring unit tests pass and results are stable across reruns
Final mark is stored per team only
